description: Inferring emotions of a natural person in the workplace or education, except for medical or safety reasons (EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(f)). Illustrative only; synthetic text.

positives.text: Analyse webcam video of employees during calls to score how engaged or frustrated each person looks and show it on the manager dashboard.
Use microphone tone analysis in the support team to rate each agent's mood through the shift and rank them by positivity.
Werte das Webcam-Video der Mitarbeiter in Calls aus, um je Person Engagement oder Frust zu bewerten und es im Manager-Dashboard anzuzeigen.
Nutze Tonanalyse im Support-Team, um die Stimmung jedes Agenten über die Schicht zu bewerten und nach Positivität zu sortieren.

hard_negatives.text: Run an anonymous quarterly engagement survey and report only team-level aggregate results.
Measure call wait times and resolution rates to plan staffing, with no inference about anyone's feelings.
Führe eine anonyme Quartalsumfrage zur Zufriedenheit durch und berichte nur aggregierte Team-Ergebnisse.
